## Appearance

Cressy Lindsay has a delicate and ethereal, fairy-like appearance. She is distinguished by her large brown eyes and a lopsided smile.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Confidences P3](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0003), [v3 ch.Weddings P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## Personality

Cressy Lindsay is a loyal individual who is completely free from snobbery and unselfish, though she can be somewhat thoughtless at times. She prefers to avoid thinking about disagreeable topics, such as broken hearts, and aims to get Mr. Hale ([Ezra](../character/ezra.md)) to propose marriage to her. Academically accomplished, she earned Honors in Mathematics, and she also possesses skillful hands capable of dressmaking. Additionally, she has acquired practical skills in shopping, cleaning dishes, and sweeping floors. Her personal fears include scarlet fever and having a green [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas), which she despises.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Again P52](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0052), [v3 ch.Place P65](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0065), [v3 ch.Relationships P66](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0066), [v3 ch.Robin P2](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0002), [v3 ch.Speaks P3](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0003), +4 more_

## History

Cressida Lindsay, a student descended from an established and elite [Bluenose](../codex/factions.md#bluenose) lineage, first met [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) at [Old St](../codex/places.md#old-st). John's Cemetery while attending [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college). The women quickly struck up a warm friendship, and Cressy subsequently used her social influence to help [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) settle into college life. After [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) arranged to rent a historic cottage called Tabby's Place for the upcoming school year, Cressy enthusiastically requested to join them as a housemate and accepted their visiting rules. Following an attempted attempt to kill Nell's cat, [Smudge](../character/smudge.md), Cressy moved into Tabby's Place alongside the other girls and [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md). During her time in college, Cressy discussed her various potential suitors and later stayed at Cousin Emily's boardinghouse in [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point), where she developed romantic feelings for an earnest theology student named [Ezra](../character/ezra.md) [Hale](../character/ezra.md). [Ezra](../character/ezra.md) eventually proposed to Cressy during an evening walk in the park, and she accepted. At the conclusion of their time at [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), Cressy offered comfort to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) after [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) rejected [Cyril](../character/cyril-lisle.md) Lisle's proposal.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P2](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0002), [v3 ch.Lady P11](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0011), [v3 ch.Lady P19](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0019), [v3 ch.Lady P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 ch.Home P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), +32 more_

## Quotes

> "No, no, my dear. Shyness is not one of the numerous faults—or good qualities—possessed by Cressida Lindsay—Cressy as a nickname. Please use Cressy for me from the start. Well then, what are your names?"
>
> — Cressy Lindsay — [v3 ch.Lady P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)

> "Provided I am able to stroll alongside Honora and Wilfred, I will attend. Such an arrangement will render the chaperone role tolerable. Your Hugh is genuinely wonderful, Nell, yet what prompts his frequent company with Goggle-eyes?"
>
> — Cressy Lindsay — [v3 ch.Park P9](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0009)

> "See—encircling the archway above the gate, written in white lettering. ‘Tabby’s Place.’ Isn’t that hilarious? Particularly along this Avenue filled with Pinehursts, Elmwolds, and Cedarcrofts? ‘Tabby’s Place,’ no less! I absolutely love it."
>
> — Cressy Lindsay — [v3 ch.Park P34](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0034)

> "It’s true that they are exceptionally sweet boys, you know. An abundance of dances, drives, and overall festivities is planned. For failing to return home alongside me during the break, Queen Nell, you will never have my forgiveness."
>
> — Cressy Lindsay — [v3 ch.Again P2](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0002)

> "I imagine a couple of quilting bees will take place; additionally, every old busybody will discuss you, both directly and in your absence. My dear, boredom will be the death of you."
>
> — Cressy Lindsay — [v3 ch.Again P4](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0004)
